title: Majority Element
statement:
Find the value that fills more than half of an array.

Contract
- `numbers` is non-null and non-empty. Values may be any `int`, including
  negative values.
- One value appears more than `numbers.length / 2` times, which means strictly
  more than half of the entries. Return that value.
- Do not mutate the array.

Examples
- `majorityElement(new int[]{3, 2, 3})` returns `3`.
- `majorityElement(new int[]{2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2})` returns `2`.
- `majorityElement(new int[]{7})` returns `7`.
hints: Counting every value in a HashMap works, but it needs O(n) extra space.
Pair each occurrence of the majority value with a different value and cancel both: because the majority fills more than half, some of its occurrences are always left over.

Keep one candidate and a count. When the count is zero, adopt the current value; otherwise add one for a match and subtract one for a mismatch. The final candidate is the answer. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
inputSyntax: Input: the values, one of which fills more than half of them, for example: [2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2]
